slido1.titleEnHtml:
Grab your phone—
let's meet you first
slido1.titleZh: 拿出手機，先認識一下你
slido1.subEn: Scan the QR to join　slido.com　·　#
slido1.noteEn: Coming up: what AI feels like to you, your department, and which AI tools you've tried.
slido1.noteZh: 等等問你：你心中的 AI 像什麼、你來自哪個系、用過哪些 AI 工具

phases.titleZh: 這門課在學什麼：三部曲
phases.noteEnHtml: No prerequisites—no programming, Git, or command line required. Every week runs Make → Test/Break → Make it yours.
phases.noteZh: 零先修——不要求程式設計、Git 或命令列背景；每週固定走 Make → Test／Break → Make it yours。

items.bodyEn: Midterm scope = Weeks 1–7. Tell a tool from a teammate, a workflow, and an agent; make images, a first web app, version safety, data and bias, source-grounded research. Week 8 multimodal, Week 9 midterm gallery.
items.bodyZh: 期中評量範圍＝第 1–7 週。分辨 AI 是工具、隊友、工作流還是 Agent；做出圖像、第一個 web app、版本安全、資料與偏誤、來源查證。第 8 週多模態、第 9 週期中作品展。

items.bodyEn: What actually counts as an agent; task contracts, action previews, permissions, dry-runs, logs, read-back, and recovery; agent-assisted data work and the limits of connecting to outside systems.
items.bodyZh: 什麼才算真正的 Agent；任務契約、動作預覽、權限、dry-run、log、read-back 與復原；Agent 輔助的資料分析，以及連接外部系統的邊界。

items.bodyEn: Turn those skills into one piece: task contract, two iterations, sources and tests, red-team and repair, then an evidence board and your own AI-collaboration rules at the festival.
items.bodyZh: 把前面的能力收成一件作品：任務契約、兩次迭代、來源與測試、紅隊與修復，最後在成果節交出證據板與個人 AI 合作準則。

destination.titleEnHtml:
Where this course leads:
an AI workflow you stay in control of
destination.titleZh: 這門課的終點：一個你管得住的 AI 工作流
destination.subEn: Not memorizing tool names—turning a real problem into work you can build, evidence, and control.
destination.subZh: 不是背工具名稱，而是把一個真實問題，變成做得出來、查得到證據、也管得住的作品。

labelsEn: What makes a real AI agent?
weeks.legendEn: ●=weekly topic　●=midterm/final milestone　·　bands=the three parts　｜　每週主題・里程碑・三部曲分段

grading.noteEnHtml: Final = an AI workflow project: combine at least one primary and one supporting AI capability, three tests, and one failure with a recovery. Brand count, technical difficulty, and public deployment earn no extra credit.
grading.noteZh: 期末＝AI 工作流專題：至少整合一項主要與一項輔助 AI 能力、三筆測試，以及一次失敗與復原。品牌數量、技術難度與公開部署本身不加分。

help.titleEn: Stuck? Here's how to reach me
help.noteEn: On Slido you can ask without raising your hand.　上 Slido，問問題不用舉手。

items.en: Use your school Office 365 account (activate NDHU Office 365 first)
items.zh: 用學校 Office 365 帳號（先啟用國立東華大學 Office 365）
建議安裝 Teams 桌面版

tools.titleZh: 課堂會親手用到的工具

items.name: Text & image generation
items.sub: a first draft you accept, revise, or reject

items.name: Data stories
items.sub: clean, chart, check two raw values

tools.noteEnHtml: Tools change, skills don't. You're graded on the task, the evidence, permissions, verification, and recovery—never on a product's interface. Conditional tools are not the shared core: not using one costs you nothing.　工具會換、能力不換；沒用某個產品不扣分。

daily.titleZh: 日常 AI 工具推薦
daily.noteEnHtml: Week 1, just pick one that fits you—no need to install them all, and no account is ever required.　第一週先挑一個順手的就好，也可以完全不辦帳號。

items.enHtml: A laptop or tablet (laptop recommended); without a device, paper and pre-generated paths carry the same weight
items.zh: 筆電或平板（建議筆電）；沒有裝置也有紙本與教師預生成的等值路徑

items.enHtml: No account, no payment—every core activity has a no-account path
items.zh: 不用先辦任何帳號、不用付費——課堂核心一律有免帳號路徑

items.enHtml: Room E403—seats near outlets go first-come
items.zh: 教室 理工二館 E403——有插座的位子先到先選

rules.titleEn: How we use AI in this course
rules.titleZh: 這門課的 AI 使用守則
rules.subEn: You may learn and create with AI—but you must:
rules.subZh: 可以用 AI 學習與創作，但你要——

items.bodyEn: Be able to say how you asked, how you revised, and why you decided that way.
items.bodyZh: 說得出你怎麼問、怎麼改、為什麼這樣決定。

items.headZh: 會查證 AI 的輸出
items.bodyEn: AI gets things wrong and makes things up; check before you hand it in. Several models agreeing only raises a hypothesis's priority—it is not evidence.
items.bodyZh: AI 會錯也會編；交出去前你要查過。多個 AI 講法一致只提高查證優先順序，不是證據。

items.headZh: 守學術誠信與安全底線
items.bodyEn: Honor integrity, privacy, and copyright. Public or synthetic data only—no personal data, real grades, private mail, or unlicensed photos and audio.
items.bodyZh: 遵守誠信、隱私與著作權；只用公開或合成資料，不輸入個資、真實成績、私人信件或未授權的照片與聲音。

slido2.titleEnHtml:
Last thing—
tell me what you hope for
slido2.noteEnHtml: Why you're taking this, what you most want AI to help you do, and one word for your hopes.
slido2.noteZh: 修課動機、你最想用 AI 幫你完成什麼事、一個詞形容你的期待

finale.titleZh: 歡迎來到人工智慧概論
finale.nextWeekEn: Next week: prompting, images, and human judgment—how to ask, how to revise, when to say no.
finale.nextWeekZh: 下週預告：提問、圖像與人的判斷——怎麼問、怎麼改、什麼時候該拒絕
finale.actionEn: Your small task: bring one problem you'd like to solve with AI.
finale.actionZh: 下週的小任務：帶一個你想用 AI 解決的問題來
